context: Capture desired, built, deployed, and observed state separately. Record exact SHAs, artifact and database digests, deployment IDs, branch protection, environment policy, accepted-path union, and live probes. Define the archive-preservation floor and incident owner before implementation starts.
description: Establish an evidence-fresh baseline before changing publication control. Inventory the live Pages deployment, release-driven deploy path, accepted published-results tree, mirror PRs, branch rules, environments, artifact sizes, deployment duration, and current live corpus identity. Declare a temporary migration freeze on destructive corpus rewrites, mirror retirement, and release-deploy removal. Counts are evidence only, never migration targets.

anti_patterns.dont: Disable the current deploy during inventory
anti_patterns.instead: freeze destructive changes while production remains intact
anti_patterns.why: there is no proven replacement yet

anti_patterns.dont: Rewrite the corpus to a clean expected count
anti_patterns.instead: compute and preserve the exact accepted path union
anti_patterns.why: a count can omit accepted published-only history

preserves.behavior: Every accepted published-results bundle and published-only path remains recoverable.
The current production deploy remains enabled until a tested replacement and rollback exist.
